```{r}
ld_mat <- as.matrix(read.table(
  file.path(reports_path, "ld", "ld_with_lead_chr10.ld"),
  header = FALSE
))

snp_ids <-  read.table(
  file.path(reports_path, "ld", "ld_with_lead_chr10.bim" ),
  header = TRUE,
  check.names = FALSE
)  

ids <- snp_ids$chr_pos

dim(ld_mat)
stopifnot(nrow(ld_mat) == length(ids), ncol(ld_mat) == length(ids))

rownames(ld_mat) <- snp_ids$chr_pos
colnames(ld_mat) <- snp_ids$chr_pos
```

```{r}
ld_long <- as.data.frame(ld_mat, check.names = FALSE) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("SNP1") |>
  pivot_longer(-SNP1, names_to = "SNP2", values_to = "r2")

```

```{r}
get_pos <- function(x) as.numeric(sub(".*_", "", x))

snp_order <- unique(ld_long$SNP1)
snp_order <- snp_order[order(get_pos(snp_order))]

ld_long <- ld_long |>
  mutate(
    SNP1 = factor(SNP1, levels = snp_order),
    SNP2 = factor(SNP2, levels = snp_order)
  )

idx <- seq_along(snp_order)
names(idx) <- snp_order

ld_long <- ld_long |>
  mutate(i = idx[as.character(SNP1)],
         j = idx[as.character(SNP2)]) |>
  filter(i >= j)

```

```{r}
assoc2 <- assoc |>
  mutate(chr_pos = sub(":.*", "", rs))

sig_snps <- assoc2 |>
  filter(p_score < 5e-6) |>
  pull(chr_pos)

intersect(sig_snps, unique(ld_long$SNP1))

ld_long <- ld_long |>
  mutate(sig_tile = SNP1 %in% sig_snps | SNP2 %in% sig_snps)

ld_chr10 <-
ggplot(ld_long, aes(SNP1, SNP2, fill = r2)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_tile(
    data = subset(ld_long, sig_tile),
    color = "black",
    fill = NA,
    linewidth = 0.15
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "magma",
    direction = -1,
    name = expression(r^2)
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "roboto_condensed") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )
```

Plot zoomed in Manhattan plot
```{r}
assoc <- data.table::fread(file.path(reports_path, "gwas", "wm-gwas.gemma_GLs_filtered.assoc.txt"))

assoc$n <- 1:nrow(assoc)
```

```{r}
assoc2 <- assoc %>%
  mutate(
    chr = str_extract(rs, "^[^_:\\s]+"),   # first chunk e.g. "chr1"
    n   = row_number(),
    p_score_safe = pmax(p_score, 1e-300)
  )

```

```{r}
# recompute bonf 
bonf <- -log10(0.00005 / nrow(assoc2))

# prepare plot_df (only points above threshold)
plot_df <- assoc2 %>%
  mutate(chr = ifelse(is.na(chr) | chr == "", str_extract(rs, "^[^_:\\s]+"), chr)) %>%
  filter(-log10(p_score_safe) > 1) %>%
  mutate(
    n = as.integer(n),                            # ensure numeric
    chr = factor(chr, levels = unique(chr)),      # keep encountered order
    chr_idx = as.integer(chr),
    point_col = ifelse(chr_idx %% 2 == 1, "#5a798f", "#2a3740")
  )

# build axisdf: midpoint for each chr on the numeric n scale
axisdf <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(chr) %>%
  summarize(x = (min(n) + max(n)) / 2) %>%
  ungroup()

manhattan_plot_chr10 <-
plot_df %>%
 mutate(
    chr_pos = sub(":.*", "", rs),
    pos = as.numeric(sub(".*_", "", chr_pos))
  )%>%
filter(chr=="chr10") %>%
filter(
    chr == "chr10",
    pos >= 7049620,
    pos <= 10925351
  ) %>%
ggplot(aes(x = n, y = -log10(p_score_safe))) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = point_col), width = 0.18, height = 0, size = 1.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = bonf, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = axisdf$x, labels = axisdf$chr, expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
  labs(title="Association peak on Chromosome 10: 7049620-10925351", x = "Chromosome 10", y = expression(-log[10](p[score]))) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "roboto_condensed") +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),                      # remove grid entirely
    axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 1, family = "roboto_condensed"),
    axis.title = element_text(family = "roboto_condensed"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

plot_df %>%
 mutate(
    chr_pos = sub(":.*", "", rs),
    pos = as.numeric(sub(".*_", "", chr_pos))
  )%>%
filter(chr=="chr8") %>% arrange(p_score) %>% slice(1:10) %>% arrange(pos)

manhattan_plot_chr8 <-
plot_df %>%
 mutate(
    chr_pos = sub(":.*", "", rs),
    pos = as.numeric(sub(".*_", "", chr_pos))
  ) %>%
filter(
    chr == "chr8",
    pos >= 2343733,
    pos <= 8301796
  ) %>%
ggplot(aes(x = n, y = -log10(p_score_safe))) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = point_col), width = 0.18, height = 0, size = 1.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = bonf, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = axisdf$x, labels = axisdf$chr, expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
  labs(title="Association peak on Chromosome 8: 2343733-8301796", x = "Chromosome 10", y = expression(-log[10](p[score]))) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "roboto_condensed") +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),                      # remove grid entirely
    axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 1, family = "roboto_condensed"),
    axis.title = element_text(family = "roboto_condensed"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

chr10 <- (manhattan_plot_chr10+ld_chr10)

ggsave(chr10,
      filename=file.path(figures_path, "association_peak_chr10.png"),
      width=8,
      height=4)

```

Test whether SNPs from the associated regions have higher LD with each other than the background 
```{r}
# extract chr_pos and numeric position from assoc table
assoc2 <- assoc %>%
  mutate(
    chr_pos = sub(":.*", "", rs),
    pos = as.numeric(sub(".*_", "", chr_pos))
  )

# define associated SNPs (choose threshold)
assoc_snps <- assoc2 %>%
  filter(p_score < 1e-5) %>%      # adjust if needed
  pull(chr_pos)

# SNP positions from LD matrix
snp_info <- tibble(
  chr_pos = rownames(ld_mat),
  pos = as.numeric(sub(".*_", "", chr_pos))
)

mean_local_ld <- function(snp, window = 25000) {
  pos_i <- snp_info$pos[snp_info$chr_pos == snp]

  neighbors <- snp_info %>%
    filter(abs(pos - pos_i) <= window) %>%
    pull(chr_pos)

  # exclude self
  neighbors <- setdiff(neighbors, snp)

  if (length(neighbors) == 0) return(NA_real_)

  mean(ld_mat[snp, neighbors], na.rm = TRUE)
}

snp_info <- snp_info %>%
  mutate(
    is_assoc = chr_pos %in% assoc_snps,
    mean_ld_25kb = sapply(chr_pos, mean_local_ld)
  )

summary_stats <- snp_info %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean_ld_25kb)) %>%
  group_by(is_assoc) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_ld = mean(mean_ld_25kb),
    median_ld = median(mean_ld_25kb),
    n = n()
  )

summary_stats

diff_ld_background_associated <- 
ggplot(snp_info, aes(x = is_assoc, y = mean_ld_25kb, fill = is_assoc)) +
  geom_half_violin(
    side = "r",
    alpha = 0.7,
    width = 0.8,
    color = NA        # 🔹 removes violin outline
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = is_assoc),
    width = 0.06,
    alpha = 0.35,
    size = 1
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 21,
    size = 3.5,
    fill = "#325a70",
    color = "#325a70"
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_cl_normal,  # mean ± 95% CI
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.05,
    color = "#325a70",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#5da2c9", "#c9bb5d")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#5da2c9", "#c9bb5d")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Background SNPs", "Associated SNPs")) +
  labs(y = "Mean r² within ±25 kb", x = "") +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "roboto_condensed") +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

ggsave(diff_ld_background_associated,
      filename=file.path(figures_path, "diff_ld_background_associated.png"),
      width=4,
      height=4)
```

```{r}

assoc_chr10 <- assoc %>%
  mutate(
    chr_pos = sub(":.*", "", rs),
    chr = sub("_.*", "", chr_pos),
    pos = as.numeric(sub(".*_", "", chr_pos))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    chr == "chr10",
    pos >= 8059620,
    pos <= 10425351
  )

assoc_sig <- assoc_chr10 %>%
  filter(p_score < 5e-8)

effect_summary <- assoc_sig %>%
  summarise(
    n_snps = n(),
    mean_beta = mean(beta),
    median_beta = median(beta),
    min_beta = min(beta),
    max_beta = max(beta),
    mean_af = mean(af),
    median_af = median(af),
    min_af = min(af),
    max_af = max(af)
  )

effect_summary

phen_sd <- sd(phenotypes_clean$hatch_date, na.rm = TRUE)

assoc_sig %>%
  mutate(beta_sd = beta / phen_sd) %>%
  summarise(
    max_abs_beta_sd = max(abs(beta_sd)),
    median_abs_beta_sd = median(abs(beta_sd)))
```
